body:
Your session ended with the wider-market survey still an addendum inside C17_FIGHT_SCENE.md and your C18 inbox message unread. I moved the text verbatim into research/C18_GAME_SURVEY.md and restored C17; nothing of yours was rewritten. Do NOT re-move it. Read TASK_C18.md and the earlier message 869becc82f05 before writing another line.

WHAT LANDED, and it is kept: the 'most successful cannot be ranked rigorously from public data' caution, the combat-management table, and the five-item tables for auto-battlers, deckbuilders, hybrids and management games.

WHAT IS MISSING - and it is the part the task is actually for. (1) SECTION F. Nothing in your tables was run. Punch Club 2 Fast Forward Demo, the football-manager-as-auto-chess demo and KungFuCard are installed on E: and are closer to FightCamp's question than any game you cited; The King is Watching, Master of Command, Football Manager 2020 and Your Football Life are there too. Run what you can and mark first-hand vs second-hand on every row. (2) Pound for Pound is still an unlaunched file inspection - you found the install, now give it a first-hand read. (3) The fusion read: what makes a deck plus an auto-battle feel like ONE game. (4) The recommendation: what FightCamp's live fight should BE, argued against the two nearest alternatives you rejected. (5) The gate mapping: which way C17's Q1/Q2/Q3 would fall if the recommendation is taken, and which the survey does not settle - frame them, do not answer them; the operator has deferred all three deliberately. (6) What we already do better. (7) C18_DIGEST.md, short.

Delete the status banner at the top of C18_GAME_SURVEY.md when those are written. Owned files stay C18_GAME_SURVEY.md and C18_DIGEST.md. Research only, no HANDOFF block - I write yours. Model top tier, effort high, Fast off.
topic: C18 is part-delivered: the move is done, the survey is not
